# Release Notes

> A professional template for documenting software releases. Replace all placeholder text (in `<angle brackets>`) with the actual release information before publishing.

---

## Version and Date

Document the release version (following [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/)) and the official release date.

- **Version:** `<MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH>` (e.g., `1.2.0`)
- **Release Date:** `<YYYY-MM-DD>` (e.g., `2025-01-15`)
- **Release Type:** `<Major | Minor | Patch | Hotfix>`
- **Status:** `<Stable | Beta | Release Candidate>`

---

## Features

List all new features and enhancements introduced in this release. Each entry should clearly describe the feature and, where helpful, link to related documentation or issue trackers.

- ✨ **`<Feature Name>`** — `<Brief description of the new feature and its user-facing benefit>`. (#`<PR/Issue-ID>`)
- ✨ **`<Feature Name>`** — `<Brief description of the new feature and its user-facing benefit>`. (#`<PR/Issue-ID>`)
- ✨ **`<Feature Name>`** — `<Brief description of the new feature and its user-facing benefit>`. (#`<PR/Issue-ID>`)

**Example:**

- ✨ **Dark Mode Support** — Added a system-aware dark theme available from the user preferences panel. (#142)

---

## Bug Fixes

Document all resolved issues, including a short summary of the problem and the fix. Reference the corresponding issue or pull request when available.

- 🐛 **`<Short title of the bug>`** — `<Description of the issue and how it was resolved>`. (#`<PR/Issue-ID>`)
- 🐛 **`<Short title of the bug>`** — `<Description of the issue and how it was resolved>`. (#`<PR/Issue-ID>`)
- 🐛 **`<Short title of the bug>`** — `<Description of the issue and how it was resolved>`. (#`<PR/Issue-ID>`)

**Example:**

- 🐛 **Login Timeout on Slow Networks** — Fixed an issue where the login request would time out prematurely on connections slower than 1 Mbps. (#118)

---

## Breaking Changes

List any changes that break backward compatibility. Provide migration guidance so users can upgrade smoothly. If there are no breaking changes in this release, state: _"No breaking changes in this release."_

- ⚠️ **`<Change title>`** — `<Description of the breaking change>`.
  - **Impact:** `<Who is affected and how>`
  - **Migration:** `<Step-by-step instructions to migrate>`

**Example:**

- ⚠️ **Removed Deprecated `getUser()` API** — The legacy `getUser()` method has been removed in favor of `fetchUser()`.
  - **Impact:** Any client still calling `getUser()` will receive a `404 Not Found` response.
  - **Migration:** Replace all calls to `getUser(id)` with `fetchUser({ id })`. See the [migration guide](#) for details.

---

## Acknowledgments

Recognize and thank the contributors, reviewers, and community members who made this release possible.

- 🙏 `<@contributor-handle>` — `<Contribution summary>`
- 🙏 `<@contributor-handle>` — `<Contribution summary>`
- 🙏 `<@contributor-handle>` — `<Contribution summary>`

A special thank you to everyone who reported bugs, suggested features, and helped test pre-release builds. Your support keeps this project moving forward. ❤️

**Example:**

- 🙏 [@janedoe](https://github.com/janedoe) — Implemented the dark mode feature and wrote accompanying documentation.
- 🙏 [@johnsmith](https://github.com/johnsmith) — Reported and helped diagnose the login timeout issue.

---

_For questions, issues, or feedback regarding this release, please open an issue in the [project repository](#) or contact the maintainers._
